summary: David Cross, 32, of Carbondale found deceased in hazardous out-of-bounds backcountry terrain near Snowmass Ski Resort after a two-day search; had ridden out of the resort boundary and was located by Snowmass Ski Patrol following a single snow track
location: Snowmass Ski Resort backcountry (West Willow area, off Village Express lift)
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Snowmass Ski Patrol
notes: Date = body-found date (Thursday 2021-01-28); last seen alive Tue 2021-01-26 11:50 a.m. boarding the Village Express lift, friend reported him missing; cause of death unclear, coroner to determine; AP wire + Unofficial Networks/CBS4 corroboration this run; fills thin year 2021 for Pitkin
